bulletins.title: High-Yield PFZ Alert: Wadge Bank & Malabar Offshore Convergence
bulletins.summary: Pronounced chlorophyll-a front (1.8 - 2.1 mg/m3) aligned with thermal front (27.6°C - 28.4°C). High probability of pelagic shoals (Tuna, Mackerel, Carangids). Safe sea venture clearance issued for craft >= 9m.

bulletins.title: IMBL Proximity & Geofencing Alert: Palk Strait Sector 4
bulletins.source: Indian Coast Guard & ORCA Geofencing Core
bulletins.summary: High vessel cluster observed within 2 NM of India-Sri Lanka IMBL boundary. Fishermen are strictly warned not to cross latitude 09°15N / longitude 79°20E. Navigational transponders must remain ACTIVE on VHF Ch 16.

bulletins.title: Squally Weather & Sea State Advisory: North Gujarat & Gulf of Kutch
bulletins.summary: Gusty winds reaching 22-26 knots with wave heights up to 2.3m expected due to low-pressure trough. Small country craft advised not to venture beyond 15 NM offshore. ETA calculations should factor 25% transit delay.

bulletins.title: Marine Protected Area Compliance: Gulf of Mannar Marine Biosphere
bulletins.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change
bulletins.summary: Mechanized trawling strictly prohibited in Core Sanctuary Zone (Islands 1 to 21). Automated AIS tracking logs all entries. Please route along designated navigation channels.
